name: Pup
desc: Cartoon puppy with optional pose (running, sitting, jumping)
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const col=ctx.color||'#FF8C42'; const scol=ctx.scol||'#D06B20'; const pose=ctx.pose||'stand'; const tailWag=ctx.tailWag!==false; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; const bob = (pose==='jump') ? Math.abs(Math.sin(mt*3))*18 : 0; const legSpread = (pose==='jump' && bob>8) ? 3 : 0; svg += `<ellipse cx="0" cy="${-3-bob}" rx="6.5" ry="4.5" fill="${col}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="4" cy="${-9-bob}" r="4.5" fill="${col}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<polygon points="1,${-13-bob} 0,${-18-bob} 4,${-14-bob}" fill="${scol}"/>`; svg += `<polygon points="7,${-13-bob} 8,${-18-bob} 5,${-14-bob}" fill="${scol}"/>`; if(pose==='sit'){ svg += `<path d="M2 ${-10-bob} Q4 ${-12-bob} 6 ${-10-bob}" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<path d="M5 ${-10-bob} Q7 ${-12-bob} 9 ${-10-bob}" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } else { svg += `<circle cx="3" cy="${-10-bob}" r="1" fill="#222"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="6" cy="${-10-bob}" r="1" fill="#222"/>`; } if(pose==='sit'){ svg += `<line x1="-2" y1="${1-bob}" x2="-3" y2="${6-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="2" y1="${1-bob}" x2="1" y2="${6-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } else if(pose==='jump'){ const lf = Math.sin(mt*3)*3; svg += `<line x1="-4" y1="${1-bob}" x2="${-6+lf}" y2="${7-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="4" y1="${1-bob}" x2="${6-lf}" y2="${7-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } else { // stand/walk const lf = Math.sin(mt*3)*3; svg += `<line x1="-3" y1="${1-bob}" x2="${-4+lf}" y2="${6-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; svg += `<line x1="3" y1="${1-bob}" x2="${4-lf}" y2="${6-bob}" stroke="${scol}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } if(tailWag){ const t = Math.sin(mt*(pose==='sit'?3:5))*12; svg += `<path d="M-7 ${-5-bob} Q-12 ${-13+t} -10 ${-17+t*0.5}" fill="none" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
